# authwise_issuers (Data Source)

An OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect issuer: the login a set of clients shares, with its token lifetimes and which realm or realms people sign in to (`config`). It answers at the hosts its `authwise_issuer_domain_binding`s name (kit#911). Its appearance is whichever of its profiles is the default (`authwise_appearance_profile.is_default`). This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `issuers` (Attributes List) Every issuer under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--issuers))
